items.title: CISA, FBI and Partners Warn Organizations of SafePay Ransomware Actors Targeting Multiple Critical Infrastructure Sectors
CVE-2026-124194: exploited vulnerability in Microsoft Office
items.note: Microsoft Office Outlook contains a missing user interaction for potentially unsafe action vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to perform spoofing over a network.

items.title: CVE-2026-111793: exploited vulnerability in Openwave Messaging Limited Webtop Media Transcoder
items.note: Openwave Messaging Limited Webtop Media Transcoder contains an incorrect resource transfer between spheres vulnerability that may allow an authenticated user to process and convert unintended document types if bypassing the Webmail experience.

items.title: CVE-2026-20320: exploited vulnerability in Cisco BroadWorks
items.note: Cisco BroadWorks contains an improper restriction of XML external entity reference vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to read sensitive configuration information on an affected system.

items.title: CVE-2026-111560: exploited vulnerability in Barracuda Networks Multiple Products
items.note: Barracuda Networks Email Security Gateway (ESG), Load Balancer, Application Delivery Controller (ADC), Message Archiver (BMA), WAF Control Center (WCC), Web Application Firewall (WAF), and Web Security Gateway (WSG) contain an OS command injection vulnerability. This vulnerability could allow an authenticated administrator to inject OS commands that execute with root privileges when the crafted timezone value is subsequently processed. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-116606

items.title: CVE-2026-116606: exploited vulnerability in Barracuda Networks Barracuda Email Security Gateway (ESG)
items.note: Barracuda Networks Email Security Gateway (ESG) contains an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to invoke a configuration-import function and restore a crafted, compatible backup archive, resulting in unauthorized modification of the appliance’s global configuration. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-111560.

items.title: CVE-2026-125350: exploited vulnerability in Google Chromium
items.note: Google Chromium contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the XML component that could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code inside the sandbox via a specially crafted webpage. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

items.title: CVE-2026-102895: exploited vulnerability in GPUStack GPUStack
items.note: GPUStack contains an improper authentication vulnerability which could allow unauthenticated administrative access, including user and model changes, persistent administrator API-key creation, disclosure of worker and cloud-provider secrets, and code execution through POST /v2/inference-backends/from-yaml.

items.title: CVE-2026-123158: exploited vulnerability in OpenBSD OpenSSH
items.note: OpenBSD OpenSSH on Linux contains an unexpected status code or return value vulnerability that could allow for authentication bypass.

items.title: CVE-2026-116779: exploited vulnerability in SignalWire FreeSwitch
items.note: SignalWire FreeSwitch contains a code injection vulnerability that permits configuration and credential disclosure, arbitrary call control, and command execution.

items.title: CVE-2026-123218: exploited vulnerability in IBM Aspera Faspex
items.note: IBM Aspera Faspex contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that could allow an authenticated user to craft a specific message to bypass authorization, causing privilege escalations.

items.title: CVE-2026-19868: exploited vulnerability in SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN
items.note: SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN contains a use of single-factor authentication vulnerability that may allow a user with valid credentials for an alternate authentication method to bypass SAML authentication controls. Successful exploitation may also bypass SAML-enforced multi-factor authentication (MFA).

items.title: CVE-2024-27834: exploited vulnerability in Apple Multiple Products
items.note: Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, Safari, tvOS and watchOS 10.5 contain an improper authentication vulnerability which could allow an attacker with arbitrary read and write capability to bypass pointer authentication.

items.title: CVE-2026-119977: exploited vulnerability in WordPress WordPress Core
items.note: WordPress WordPress Core contains a time-of-check time-of-use (TOCTOU) race condition vulnerability that could allow unauthenticated attackers to execute code on the server during the upgrade window. This is due to predictable, web-accessible staging paths used during full-package core upgrades.

items.title: CVE-2026-118527: exploited vulnerability in Ivanti Connect Secure
items.note: Ivanti Connect Secure contains a generation of predictable numbers or identifiers vulnerability that allows a remote authenticated attacker to upload files with attacker-controlled content to a known location on disk. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-104935 and CVE-2026-111357.

items.title: CVE-2026-111357: exploited vulnerability in Ivanti Connect Secure
items.note: Ivanti Connect Secure contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability that could allow a local authenticated attacker to escalate their privileges. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-104935 and CVE-2026-118527.

items.title: CVE-2021-38299: recently changed critical CVE
items.note: Webauthn Framework 3.3.x before 3.3.4 has Incorrect Access Control. An attacker that controls a user's system is able to login to a vulnerable service using an attached FIDO2 authenticator without passing a check of the user presence.

items.title: CVE-2022-22274: recently changed critical CVE
items.note: A Stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in the SonicOS via HTTP request allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to cause Denial of Service (DoS) or potentially results in code execution in the firewall.

items.title: CVE-2022-45088: recently changed critical CVE
items.note:
Improper Input Validation vulnerability in Group Arge Energy and Control Systems Smartpower Web allows PHP Local File Inclusion.

This issue affects Smartpower Web: before 23.01.01.

items.title: CVE-2022-2504: recently changed critical CVE
items.note:
Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection') vulnerability in SDD Computer Software SDD-Baro allows SQL Injection.

This issue affects SDD-Baro: before 2.8.432.

items.title: CVE-2022-3760: recently changed critical CVE
items.note:
Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection') vulnerability in Mia Technology Mia-Med.

This issue affects Mia-Med: before 1.0.0.58.

items.title: CVE-2023-28531: recently changed critical CVE
items.note: ssh-add in OpenSSH before 9.3 adds smartcard keys to ssh-agent without the intended per-hop destination constraints. The earliest affected version is 8.9.

items.title: CVE-2022-4146: recently changed critical CVE
items.note: Expression Language Injection vulnerability in Hitachi Replication Manager on Windows, Linux, Solaris allows Code Injection.This issue affects Hitachi Replication Manager: before 8.8.5-02.

items.title: CVE-2022-4920: recently changed critical CVE
items.note: Heap buffer overflow in Blink in Google Chrome prior to 101.0.4951.41 allowed a remote attacker who convinced a user to engage in specific UI gestures to potentially perform a sandbox escape via a crafted HTML page. (Chromium security severity: High)

items.title: CVE-2022-4924: recently changed critical CVE
items.note: Use after free in WebRTC in Google Chrome prior to 97.0.4692.71 allowed a remote attacker who had compromised the renderer process to potentially perform a sandbox escape via a crafted HTML page. (Chromium security severity: High)

items.title: CVE-2023-38186: recently changed critical CVE
items.note: Windows Mobile Device Management Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability

items.title: CVE-2023-35085: recently changed critical CVE
items.note:
An integer overflow vulnerability in all UniFi Access Points and Switches, excluding the Switch Flex Mini, with SNMP Monitoring and default settings enabled could allow a Remote Code Execution (RCE).

 

Affected Products:
All UniFi Access Points (Version 6.5.50 and earlier)
All UniFi Switches (Version 6.5.32 and earlier) 
-USW Flex Mini excluded.
 

Mitigation:
Update UniFi Access Points to Version 6.5.62 or later.
Update the UniFi Switches to Version 6.5.59 or later.

items.title: CVE-2023-38034: recently changed critical CVE
items.note:
A command injection vulnerability in the DHCP Client function of all UniFi Access Points and Switches, excluding the Switch Flex Mini, could allow a Remote Code Execution (RCE).

 
Affected Products:
All UniFi Access Points (Version 6.5.53 and earlier)
All UniFi Switches (Version 6.5.32 and earlier) 
-USW Flex Mini excluded.
 

Mitigation:
Update UniFi Access Points to Version 6.5.62 or later.
Update UniFi Switches to Version 6.5.59 or later.

items.title: AfD
items.source: Have I Been Pwned breach catalog
items.note: In September 2026, the German political party Alternative für Deutschland (AfD) suffered a data breach which exposed 345k unique email addresses. The following month, hundreds of gigabytes of data containing hundreds of thousands of emails and attachments was published online, with searchable AI-generated summaries and downloadable original files.

items.title: Data broker privacy watch
items.note: Recheck broker opt-out results every 30-90 days; many brokers repopulate data. Keep broker name, profile URL, date requested, and confirmation emails.

items.title: Unwanted software / bloatware watch
items.note: Watch for software that changes browser settings, injects ads, bundles unwanted offers, hides removal paths, exaggerates cleanup claims, or uses misleading install prompts.

items.title: Remote-access scam reminder
items.source: WireShield guidance from FTC/CISA-style scam prevention
items.note: Treat unexpected requests to install AnyDesk, TeamViewer, UltraViewer, RustDesk, or ScreenConnect as high risk, especially when paired with refunds, bank warnings, crypto, or gift cards.
